LGBTQ+ Influencer Mad Sandhu Shot Dead in Amritsar

Social media influencer and makeup artist Mad Sandhu was shot dead by motorcycle-borne assailants in Amritsar, Punjab. Police have registered an FIR and launched a probe into the incident. Sandhu, who identified as LGBTQ+, had a significant following on Instagram with over 2 lakh followers and had also worked in Punjabi films.
